reference_sql:
WITH lines_2024 AS (  -- one row per 2024 order line
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
),
line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching lines
  SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM lines_2024
  GROUP BY store_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
),
per_store AS (  -- one row per store with 2024 lines
  SELECT store_id, SUM(n_lines) AS n_lines, SUM(n_lines - 1) AS n_copies
  FROM line_sets
  GROUP BY store_id
),
shares AS (  -- one row per store
  SELECT s.store_code, COALESCE(ps.n_lines, 0) AS n_lines, COALESCE(ps.n_copies, 0) AS n_copies,
         ps.n_copies / NULLIF(ps.n_lines, 0) AS copy_share
  FROM stores s
  LEFT JOIN per_store ps ON ps.store_id = s.store_id
)
SELECT store_code, n_lines, n_copies, copy_share,
       CASE WHEN copy_share IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN copy_share < 0.001 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM shares

solver.query:
WITH sets AS (SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur),
per_store AS (
  SELECT o.store_id, SUM(s.n) AS n_lines, SUM(s.n - 1) AS n_copies
  FROM sets s
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.store_id
),
r AS (
  SELECT st.store_code, COALESCE(ps.n_lines, 0) AS n_lines, COALESCE(ps.n_copies, 0) AS n_copies,
         ps.n_copies * 1.0 / NULLIF(ps.n_lines, 0) AS copy_share
  FROM stores st
  LEFT JOIN per_store ps ON ps.store_id = st.store_id
)
SELECT store_code, n_lines, n_copies, copy_share,
       CASE WHEN copy_share IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN copy_share < 0.001 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM r
